title: Keyframe button on shader parameters disappear after clicking on a keyframe.
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.5.1, 4.4.1, 4.3

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-10300H CPU @ 2.50GHz (8 threads) - 15.83 GiB memory

### Issue description

The keyframe buttons on shader parameters will be gone if you click on a keyframe in the animation tab then click back on the node with the shader.

I've been making animations that required me to animate shader properties, and I found that the keyframe buttons kept disappearing for seemingly no reason. Every time it happened I had to find and click back on the animation player node, and then reclick on the node I was trying to animate. This also restarts the animation to the beginning and I have to find where I was at.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f8c3d02a-e6c8-4834-96db-e25cea6e59f4


While testing the issue, I've also found the opposite problem: When in the animation tab and all of the keyframe buttons are visible, if you switch the bottom panel tab to something other than Animation, shader parameters will keep its keyframe buttons! While every other keyframe button will be gone, as you would expect. This is purely a visual bug, and clicking on the keyframe button does nothing.

### Steps to reproduce

- Have an AnimationPlayer node and a node containting a ShaderMaterial with shader parameters.
- Click on the AnimationPlayer then click on the shader node to make the keyframe buttons appear. (pin the bottom panel so it doesn't switch to the shader editor tab)
- Click on any keyframe in the animation panel so the inspector tab shows the properties of the keyframe.
- Click back on the node with the shader.
- All of the keyframe buttons on the shader parameters will be gone, every other keyframe button stays intact.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[disappearing_keyframe_button.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22981104/disappearing_keyframe_button.zip)
